import sys,time,json,statistics
sys.path.insert(0,'src')
import numpy as np
from scpn_phase_orchestrator.coupling import connectome as c
records=[]
for n in (20,80,200):
 timings=[]
 for _ in range(50):
  c._load_hcp_connectome_cached.cache_clear()
  t=time.perf_counter();k=c.load_hcp_connectome(n,seed=42);timings.append((time.perf_counter()-t)*1e6)
 assert k.shape==(n,n) and np.all(np.isfinite(k)) and np.all(k>=0)
 np.testing.assert_array_equal(k,k.T);np.testing.assert_array_equal(np.diag(k),np.zeros(n))
 np.testing.assert_array_equal(k,c.load_hcp_connectome(n,seed=42))
 records.append({'n':n,'public_cold_median_us':statistics.median(timings),'finite_nonnegative_symmetric_zero_diagonal':True,'deterministic':True})
print(json.dumps({'numpy':np.__version__,'python':sys.version.split()[0],'rust_active':c._HAS_RUST,'records':records}))
